Best Co-Op Games on Switch (2026)

Roundup · Updated 2026-08-05

The Switch is the best couch-co-op console on the market. If you play with family or friends in the same room, these are the titles worth owning.

1. Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

The gold standard for pick-up-and-play multiplayer. Up to 4 systems locally, 12 online, and smart-steering makes it kid-friendly.

Check Mario Kart

2. Super Mario Bros. Wonder

Up to 4 players in the same world, with the chaotic Elephant form a hit with younger players. The most modern 2D Mario.

Check SMB Wonder

3. Animal Crossing: New Horizons

Not competitive — just a shared island you visit together. Perfect for relaxed co-op sessions.

Check Animal Crossing

4. Pokémon Scarlet & Violet

Four-player co-op in the open world — explore, battle, and trade together.

Check Pokémon

Buying tip

First-party Switch games hold price, so the "cheapest" angle is usually about where you have credit (eShop funds, retailer gift cards) rather than deep discounts. Watch Black Friday and the Nintendo eShop seasonal sales.
